summary.intent: Improve memory quality in the memory-loop system by adding a hard evidence gate that requires generated memories to be backed by verifiable, multi-session signals from upstream analysis. Also fix performance and display issues in the summary command.
summary.outcome: Implemented a two-layer evidence gate (provenance + session ID validation) replacing the old `passesReviewDerivedGate`, moved JSON extraction to a shared utility to fix LLM trailing-text parse failures across multiple packages, removed unconditional backfill from the summary command, and fixed the summary TUI branch filter to default to current branch with only two meaningful options.

repo: The memory generator's 'stability' enforcement was entirely prompt-based with no hard code gates; post-filter only caught weak/generic/duplicate records but not episodic one-offs with high confidence scores.
PatternAnalysis signals (RepeatedInstructions, SkillOpportunities, ReviewDerivedRules) carry Count and AffectedSessions fields that can be used as deterministic evidence for generated memories.

SkillOpportunities were filtered out at count < 2 in improve/analyzer.go BEFORE reaching the generator, making the singleton exception in the evidence gate unreachable until the threshold was lowered to >= 1.
AffectedSessions in PatternAnalysis used CheckpointIDs while the generator prompt exposed SessionIDs — identifier mismatch required switching prompt to use CheckpointIDs.
The summary command ran unconditional backfill (summaries + facets) on every invocation via io.Discard, causing 50-170 seconds of silent LLM calls on first load.
The 'repo' branch filter in summary TUI filtered to defaultBranch (main/master) but no sessions were ever recorded on main since work happens on feature branches — filter was always empty.
LLM responses often include trailing text after the JSON object; json.Unmarshal fails with 'invalid character after top-level value' — requires extracting the balanced {…} before unmarshaling.
facets/facets.go, improve/generator.go, and memoryloop/generator.go all had the same JSON parse vulnerability independently.

code.finding: Prompt instruction 'avoid one-off incidents' was the only stability enforcement — not a code gate
Post-filter caught low-confidence/weak records but a high-confidence singleton sailed through
SourceSessionIDs was captured but never validated for length or cross-referenced against signal AffectedSessions
passesReviewDerivedGate enforced count >= 2 || strong only for review-derived rules, not repo_rule/workflow_rule/agent_instruction kinds — replaced by passesEvidenceGate
count < 2 threshold dropped skill opportunities before generator saw them, making singleton exception in evidence gate unreachable — lowered to >= 1
Unconditional backfill of summaries and facets on every invocation — removed; LLM calls now only happen on user-initiated generation
Detail pane checked row.HasFacets but facets were never populated because backfill was removed and json parse errors silently failed
Added ExtractJSONObject as shared utility; finds first balanced {…} in LLM response to handle trailing text

workflow: Codex was used as a code review tool by writing analysis to a markdown file (MEMORY_QUALITY_ANALYSIS.md) and iterating on it collaboratively between Claude and Codex.
The 'reject by default on no provenance' pattern (hard reject rather than allow-if-unmatched fallback) is the correct approach when adding evidence gates — fallback-allow nullifies the gate.
Shared JSON extraction utilities should be placed in jsonutil package rather than duplicated across packages when the same LLM response parsing pattern is needed in multiple places.

friction: LLM JSON trailing-text bug hit three separate times: memory-loop refresh, then facet extraction in summary TUI — required fix in 3+ separate files
Rebuilt binary was needed after the first JSON fix commit but the CLI wasn't automatically rebuilt, causing the same error to appear again
The identifier mismatch (CheckpointID vs SessionID) between PatternAnalysis.AffectedSessions and the generator prompt was a prerequisite blocker that required careful handling
Multiple test files needed updating after removing defaultBranch parameter from RunWithCurrentBranch — replace_all missed some call sites with slightly different argument patterns
The cycle logic for branch filters needed to change from % 3 to % 2 after removing the 'repo' filter option, with several test assertions to update
metadataToSessionRow returns a fresh struct without preserving existing facet data — needed careful reading to confirm the order of operations was still correct after row replacement
open_items: The findSignal lookup strategy uses normalized exact match with substring fallback — false-negative rate when LLM paraphrases signal keys is not fully characterized
Existing low-quality memories already in memory-loop.json are not backfilled/re-evaluated by the new evidence gate — natural decay or a manual re-evaluation pass may be needed
improve/generator.go was patched for the JSON extraction issue but may have other LLM response parsing edge cases not yet tested
The full test suite run was interrupted before completion — final green status was not confirmed for all packages
